    The ray category of a minimal representation-infinite algebra is connected #

    A set V of objects with no nonzero morphism between V and its complement gives a central idempotent Σ_{v ∈ V} e_v of B, which is 0 or 1 (IsMinimalRepInfinite.central_idempotent); so V is empty or everything (SplitBasicData.isolated_trivial, and isolated_trivial_small for the small model).

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.Isolated {Q : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} Q] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms Q] (V : Set Q) :
    Prop

    V is a union of connected components: no nonzero morphism leaves or enters it.
